cards.title: Social media management
cards.lede: Founder-led content for a premium textiles house.
cards.note: Content, production and monthly reporting included.

groups.title: Content & production
points: 10–12 reels every month
2–3 carousels per month
17–18 pieces in total, per month
3 shoot days, planned in advance
B-roll from existing footage
Educational and trending formats
Indirect-sales storytelling, never hard selling
AI presentations, models and moodboards

groups.title: Positioning & audience
points: Founder-led, premium brand positioning
English-language content throughout
Audience: interior designers, architects, hotel and restaurant buyers, premium homeowners
Awareness as the first measurable goal
No price or discount promotions
Separate creatives for separate price segments

groups.title: Reach, leads & reporting
points: Lead tracking from comment and DM to enquiry
Location SEO for Mumbai discovery
Content that builds store curiosity and catalogue interest
Product expertise and fabric variety shown, not claimed
Monthly review focused on quality leads

cards.title: Performance marketing
cards.lede: Meta and ChatGPT ads, built for qualified enquiries.
cards.note: Ad spend billed separately, directly to the platform. ChatGPT ads subject to market availability.

groups.title: Targeting & awareness
points: Interest, behaviour and location targeting for designers, trade and premium buyers.
Awareness campaigns that introduce the brand to cold audiences.

groups.title: Retargeting, creative & testing
points: Retargeting for site visitors, engagers and past enquiries.
Fresh creative produced and tested every cycle.
Structured creative testing across hooks, formats and audiences.

groups.title: Quality, tracking & optimisation
points: Lead-quality screening, with forms tuned for serious buyers.
Pixel, conversions API and campaign tracking set up and maintained.
Monthly reporting on leads, cost per lead and lead quality.
Continuous optimisation of audiences, creative and placements.
Budget guidance, with month one run as an awareness-led launch.
